title: Content Manifest
description: Top-level index of available exams (schemaVersion 1). The app fetches this file first to compare versions before downloading any exam.

schemaVersion.description: Content schema contract version. Must match exam.schema.json schemaVersion.

contentVersion.description: Index-wide content version. Bumped whenever the manifest itself changes.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 date of the last content publish.

id.description: Exam id. Must match the exam file's 'id'.

version.description: Latest published exam content version. Compared with the locally stored version.

file.description: Relative path of the exam file in the content repository (e.g. 'exams/quran_qalon.json').

sha256.description: Lowercase or uppercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the exact exam payload bytes.

category.description: Optional category id for grouping in catalogs.

questionCount.description: Optional known question count, shown in the UI before download.

updatedAt.description: Optional publish date of this exam.
